call.detail: Webcast at 08:30 ET this morning, so it is over before the open; its content was not reviewed in time. No call risk remains inside the session.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions dated this morning were found (every price-target hit was from 2025). The headlines (rttnews, StockTwits) say the stock is up pre-market, snippet_only. Retail tone was not measured beyond those headlines.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 50.26 (+18.4%) against a frozen release read of +20%: close to fair, slightly short of it. The pre-market is active (222 prints, 31 in the last 30 min, last print 09:16, not stale) but swung widely, from a 54.35 high (+28%) down to a 40.68 low, so it ran up and then sagged. The move already exceeds the 13.3% implied move. QQQ is -1.1% pre-market, a mild headwind.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was that Vector would beat the 19-21% q/q growth the guide implied. It grew 40% q/q, and the Q4 Grow guide implies about 20% more q/q, far above consensus.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and was not stale at 09:16, so the open should hold most of the +18% move. A gap this large usually gives some back in the first half hour, and it already sagged from +28% before the open. A clean beat-and-raise in a bmo name tends to keep repricing later in the session, which is why the open-to-close leg leans up.

recommendation.limit_basis: About +24.8% on yesterday's close, inside the pre-market range (high 54.35) and about 5% above the 50.26 reference. A bmo beat-and-raise this clean can retest the pre-market high during the session. If it does not, the position goes at the close, where the release read (+20%) says it should end up at least where it is now.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de these ruim: Vector groeide 40% in een kwartaal en de vooruitzichten voor Q4 liggen ver boven de verwachtingen. De voorbeurskoers (+18%) houdt dat ongeveer in, maar nog niet helemaal. Zet een verkooplimiet op 53,00. Wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot, zodat de koers de hele dag de tijd heeft om de cijfers verder te verwerken.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terug onder ongeveer 47 (+11%), dan verkopen bij de opening in plaats van wachten.
